scripts.title: Auto Collect hourgl*es
scripts.features: auto farm hourglasses quiet game, this script is very very useless to people who doesn't want the ugc items
scripts.script:
game.workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(hourglass)
    if hourglass.Name == "Hourglass" then
	wait(0.1)
        for _, part in pairs(hourglass:GetChildren()) do
            if part.Name == "PrimaryPart" then
		part.Transparency = 1
		part.CanCollide = false
                part.CFrame = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
            elseif part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Mesh") then
		part.Transparency = 1
		part.CanCollide = false
	    end
        end
    end
end)
